rows.label: tlk006501_02_msg0001
rows.name:
It's not like I've
forgiven those brats.

rows.label: tlk006501_02_msg0002
rows.name:
They might look like they're working
hard, but they're the ones who stole,
you know?

rows.label: tlk006501_02_msg0003
rows.name:
Even if your home is gone and you're
just trying to survive, stealing
is still wrong.

rows.label: tlk006501_02_msg0004
rows.name:
I don't know what they'll pull next.
I can't let my guard down yet.
